components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .45rem; min-height: 44px; padding: .5rem 1rem; font: inherit; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; color: var(--text, #14202e); background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--control-border, #6b7686); border-radius: 4px; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--surface-2, #eef2f6); } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--action, #14202e); color: var(--action-text, #fff); border-color: var(--action, #14202e); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--action, #14202e); filter: brightness(1.15); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #0b5cad); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Secondary action: white fill, control-edge border.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: .5rem 1rem; font: inherit; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; color: var(--text, #14202e); background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--control-border, #6b7686); border-radius: 4px; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--surface-2, #eef2f6); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #0b5cad); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Square 44px field with a control-edge border.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: .5rem .7rem; font: inherit; color: var(--text, #14202e); background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--control-border, #6b7686); border-radius: 4px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #4c5b6b); opacity: 1; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #0b5cad); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Site Navigation
components.description: Ink shell bar with flat links and a 3px underline on the current page.

components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 2rem; padding: 0 1rem; min-height: 56px; background: var(--shell, #14202e); color: var(--shell-text, #fff); } .ds-brand { font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1875rem; letter-spacing: -.01em; } .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: .25rem; } .ds-nav a { padding: 0 .75rem; line-height: 56px; color: var(--shell-muted, #b9c4d0); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--shell-text, #fff); } .ds-nav a[aria-current=page] { color: var(--shell-text, #fff); border-bottom-color: var(--shell-text, #fff); }

components.name: Chip Radio Group
components.description: Square option tags; the selected one inverts to ink.
components.css: .ds-opts { display: flex; gap: .3rem; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-opt { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.25rem; padding: .3rem .75rem; font-size: .9375rem; font-weight: 550; cursor: pointer; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--text, #14202e); border: 1px solid var(--control-border, #6b7686); border-radius: 4px; } .ds-opt:hover { background: var(--surface-2, #eef2f6); } .ds-opt-on { background: var(--action, #14202e); border-color: var(--action, #14202e); color: var(--action-text, #fff); font-weight: 650; }

components.name: Status Ladder
components.description: Four-step teal maturity indicator; steps fill up to the trend's maturity. Teal only ever means this.
components.css: .ds-ladder { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; vertical-align: middle; } .ds-ladder i { display: block; width: 13px; height: 9px; background: var(--st0, #cfd8e1); border-radius: 1px; } .ds-ladder[data-step="3"] i.on { background: var(--st3, #14776f); }

components.name: Trend Table Row
components.description: Register in place of cards: sunk label header, hairline rows, trend link left, fixed score columns right.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--border, #d5dde6); border-radius: 6px; } .ds-table th { padding: .55rem .5rem; text-align: left; font-size: .8125rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; color: var(--muted, #4c5b6b); background: var(--surface-2, #eef2f6); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #d5dde6); } .ds-table td { padding: .7rem .5rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--border, #d5dde6); vertical-align: top; } .ds-table tbody tr:first-child td { border-top: 0; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text, #14202e) 3%, var(--surface, #fff)); } .ds-table a { font-weight: 650; color: var(--text, #14202e); text-decoration: none; } .ds-table a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-cat { display: block; color: var(--muted, #4c5b6b); font-size: .9375rem; }

components.name: Unconfirmed Badge
components.description: Amber tag for claims that need verification; text always present.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .4rem; padding: .1rem .55rem; font-size: .9063rem; line-height: 1.5; font-weight: 550; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d5dde6); background: var(--surface-2, #eef2f6); color: var(--text, #14202e); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge-warn { background: var(--warn-bg, #fff3d6); color: var(--warn-text, #5a3300); border-color: var(--warn-border, #b45309); font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
The site reads like the status page of a standards body: a cool paper ground, an ink-navy shell and ink type, hairline rules, and a register of rows where a card grid might have been. Every decision serves scanning. Maturity is the one thing the page colors, and it does so on a four-step teal ladder; everything else is ink, paper and gray-blue.

Density is moderate and tabular. Trends, recommendations and feed items are rows in tables with fixed score columns on the right and readable prose on the left. Controls are square (4px) and panels barely rounded (6px). Depth comes from hairline borders and tonal steps; nothing floats. Light and dark both ship and follow prefers-color-scheme.
keyCharacteristics: Ink is the action color: primary buttons, selected chips, selected tabs, the current nav item.
Teal appears only as the four-step maturity ladder.
Amber appears only for unconfirmed claims.
Registers (tables) replace cards; mobile reflows rows into stacked bordered rows.
One authored motion moment: the route entrance.

rules.name: The Teal-Means-Maturity Rule
rules.body: Teal is never used for links, buttons, success, or decoration. If it is teal, it states a maturity step.

rules.name: The Amber-Means-Unconfirmed Rule
rules.body: Amber marks a claim that could not be verified. It is never used for generic warnings, highlights or emphasis.

rules.name: The Ink-Is-Action Rule
rules.body: Anything the visitor can act on resolves to ink fill or ink text, selected or primary; selection is shown by inversion, not by a new hue.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Source Sans 3 only. Do not add a display face or a second sans.

rules.name: The Label-Over-Data Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked labels appear only as column heads, field labels and definition terms attached to data, never as free-floating text above headings.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate with a hairline or a tonal step. Selection and hover are fill changes (ink inversion, a 3 to 7 percent ink tint), never lift.

dos: Do keep teal for the maturity ladder and nothing else.
Do keep amber for unconfirmed claims and pair it with the words ("Needs verification").
Do use ink fill with inverse text for primary, selected and current states.
Do present repeated records as registers: wide content column left, fixed nowrap score columns right, hairline row rules.
Do use 4px radius for controls and 6px for panels and tables; use control-edge borders on anything interactive and hairline borders on anything that is only a container.
Do pair every mark (ladder, bars, icons) with text.
Do keep the 3px focus outline (blue in light, gold in dark and on the shell).
donts: Don't add box-shadows, gradients on surfaces, or glass; the only gradient is the skeleton shimmer.
Don't turn registers into card grids.
Don't introduce a second typeface or a new accent hue.
Don't use teal or amber as decoration, hover color or link color.
Don't rely on color alone to carry status or priority.
Don't animate anything beyond the route entrance and skeleton.
